title: C18 Optimistic UI (graded on rollback/failure path)

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: useOptimistic drives an immediate UI update for reviews/likes before the server responds (optimistic state visible instantly).

On a forced server rejection the UI rolls back to the pre-action state and shows an error message — no phantom update remains and no React/hydration error is thrown (QA functional: optimistic UI rolls back correctly when the server rejects the mutation).
After a successful mutation the optimistic value reconciles with the revalidated server data (the displayed value matches the server's authoritative count, not a drifted optimistic guess).
NOTES.md documents the failure/rollback path and the reconciliation-with-revalidated-data behaviour as the graded focus.

The c18 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; mutations may auth via the frozen lib/auth interface but must not edit lib/auth or lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
